events.subtitle: Tourist History 15th Anniversary Tour — with STRFKR
events.category: Culturally significant indie rock / Full-album anniversary repertoire
events.factual_description: I.M.P. presents Two Door Cinema Club's Tourist History 15th Anniversary Tour at The Anthem in Washington, DC on Sunday, October 11, 2026, with doors at 6:30 PM and the show at 8:00 PM; STRFKR is the announced support act. I.M.P.'s exact event page identifies Two Door Cinema Club's core trio as Alex Trimble, Sam Halliday and Kevin Baird and centers the tour title on the band's 2010 debut Tourist History. Consequence's March 13 tour announcement reports that the North American anniversary run performs Tourist History in full along with later greatest hits and lists the Washington date among a broad multi-city itinerary. Apple Music verifies the 2010 album and its ten-track original edition.

enrichment.note: I.M.P. and Ticketmaster verify the exact Washington event, date, venue and 8:00 PM show time; I.M.P. verifies 6:30 PM doors, STRFKR support and the core trio. Consequence supplies the authoritative full-album-tour context, and Apple Music verifies the exact Tourist History album destination. No ticket price was stored because an original face value was not exposed in the verified sources consulted.

en.why_it_matters: The hook is the repertoire, not a routine arena-scale tour stop. Tourist History compressed clipped guitars, post-punk momentum and electronic dance energy into one of the records that defined the early-2010s indie-club crossover; this tour puts the full debut back in sequence rather than reducing that period to its biggest singles. At The Anthem, the anniversary format offers a useful chance to hear whether the album still works as a continuous live object fifteen-plus years after it broke the band internationally.
en.trip_verdict: If Sunday is open, this is a strong local night to fold into the calendar rather than reorganize the month around. The Anthem is easy enough to treat as an attend-if-convenient proposition, and the full-album format is the reason to choose this stop over a standard Two Door Cinema Club set.

es.why_it_matters: El gancho está en el repertorio, no en otra parada grande de gira. Tourist History comprimió guitarras cortadas, impulso post-punk y energía electrónica de pista en uno de los discos que marcaron el cruce indie-bailable de principios de los 2010; esta gira devuelve el debut completo a su secuencia original en vez de reducir esa etapa a sus sencillos más conocidos. En The Anthem, el formato de aniversario permite escuchar si el álbum todavía funciona como una pieza continua en vivo más de quince años después de haber lanzado internacionalmente a la banda.
es.trip_verdict: Si el domingo está libre, lo incorporaría al calendario como una muy buena noche local sin reorganizar el mes alrededor del concierto. The Anthem hace fácil caerle si conviene, y el álbum completo es la razón concreta para escoger esta fecha por encima de un set estándar de Two Door Cinema Club.
